name: CognitionBioChem
description: A structural pharmacology workbench for cognition-related CNS targets, built so that a displayed number must trace to a computation. Runs Boltz-2 locally for structure prediction, validates chemistry with RDKit, enforces a provenance record on every value, and reports eight studies pre-registered under content hashes before any data was seen. Its headline result is negative: designed peptides did not separate from composition-matched shuffles of their own amino acids.

download.note: Replace with the release tarball once tagged

_edam_terms_to_select_on_the_form.note: bio.tools requires EDAM ontology URIs for topic and operation. They are not written here because guessing an ontology URI is worse than leaving it blank: a wrong one is trusted by curators and by every downstream query. Pick these term NAMES in the form's autocomplete, which resolves the URIs.
